instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure 'lucide-react' is used for all icon needs. Do not use generic emoji unless debugging.

This is a mobile-first app wrapper. Wrap the main app routes inside a container with 'w-full flex flex-col md:max-w-md md:mx-auto min-h-[100dvh] relative overflow-x-hidden' to simulate a mobile app on desktop.
CRITICAL: Do not use rounded cards. Use 'rounded-sm' or 'rounded-none'. We are going for a strict, military-grade logistics UI look (Uber Driver style).
CRITICAL: Every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, list items) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute as per accessibility rules.
Navigation should stick to the bottom. Add 'pb-28' to the main scrollable container to prevent content from hiding behind the tab bar.
The primary accent color is High-Vis Yellow (#FACC15). Use this sparingly for active states or primary 'Start/Complete Job' CTAs.
Avoid descriptive marketing text. Use data-dense labels (e.g., 'ARRIVE: 14:00', 'UPLOAD: 23/45').
Ensure there are no full-screen gradients. Keep backgrounds solid, matte black (#050505 or #121212) with sharp 1px borders.
Job Cards should clearly display the status via colored text or badges. Over-index on negative space and clear alignment.
For the Schedule timeline view, use vertical lines (border-l-2 border-zinc-800) connecting the timeslots to create a robust structural grid.
